Join to apply for the Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition role at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a vertically integrated digital agency pioneering the next generation of consumer-facing brands. A category leader in results-driven growth marketing, Darkroom’s success is attributed to our unique partnership model, purposefully built to launch brands to market and accelerate growth across direct-to-consumer. Our model is predicated on three major partnership structures - Growth & Scaling, Digital Platforms, and Brand & Product Launches – threaded by one cohesive, interdisciplinary team.

Taking the startup mindset to the agency space, the collective expertise of our team of entrepreneurs and senior digital marketers are deeply aware of the newest trends in e-commerce, development, and digital marketing. Our learned experience has allowed us to take clients (and internal ventures) from $0 to millions in revenue in just a few months. We work with game-changing brands: Crate & Barrel, Popchips, FEED, Olipop, & CALPAK, to name a few.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Dark Arts service, that has been newly relaunched as the AI-powered creative direction service for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

What its like to work at Darkroom:

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Darkweek, Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, our annual “Darkweek” summer break, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Start Date: ASAP

title: Associate Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Associate Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

11 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Associate Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you:

  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
Descrição da empresa

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Descrição do emprego

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, andsupport and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As parte of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.
Qualificações
  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Post Graduation in engineering or economics;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

description:
Would you like to work with meaningful products that help protect the environment and people? In our team, you’ll be part of developing and delivering tomorrow's solutions for oil spill response and high-pressure tents, as well as specialized products for industries like aquaculture and fisheries.

Employment Type

Permanent

NorLense is engaged in developing and producing oil spill response equipment that contributes to safeguarding clean seas and coastlines. Our high-pressure tents serve as field hospitals worldwide, among other uses. The position in our technical department offers strong opportunities for personal growth and influence in a vibrant and forward-thinking environment. As we’re expanding, we’re looking for more talented and friendly team members!

NorLense AS is a leading supplier in the development and production of equipment for oil spill response, field preparedness (tents), and aquaculture. Established in 1975, the company has been a pioneer in its field ever since.

Operating in a demanding and quality-focused market, NorLense has built a strong reputation as a provider of emergency equipment for clients such as the defense sector, NATO, and international aquaculture businesses.

Currently, we have more than 50 employees and are consistently growing. The owners have a long-term vision with clear goals for expansion. The business is managed from our headquarters in Fiskebøl, located in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen, and we also have sales offices in Sandvika, the UK, Rio de Janeiro (Brazil), and Dampier (Australia).

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
QA/QC Engineer | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.
  • Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.
  • Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.
  • Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.
  • Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.
  • Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.
  • Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.
  • Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.
  • Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.
  • Familiarity with MEP works is advantageous.
  • Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Analista comercial

Sobre a Lobie

A Lobie é a proptech que está revolucionando a gestão de imóveis para investidores. Nascemos de um grupo com mais de 80 anos de história e expertise no mercado imobiliário, combinando a solidez de uma das maiores construtoras do país com a capilaridade de uma administradora líder em gestão de condomínios.

Nossa missão é maximizar a rentabilidade de propriedades localizadas em pontos estratégicos através da locação de curto prazo (Short-Term Rental). Fazemos isso sob o lema

"Low Cost, High Yield" , garantindo uma gestão completa, transparente e altamente eficiente, com uma taxa de ocupação média superior a 85% em nossas mais de 750 unidades contratadas.

A Oportunidade: Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile)

Você já se perguntou o que acontece depois que um investidor compra um apartamento na planta? É aí que você entra.

Esta não é uma venda tradicional; é o início de um relacionamento de longo prazo. Você será o rosto da Lobie no momento mais crucial: a ativação do ativo do nosso cliente.

Seu papel será garantir que cada investidor que adquire uma unidade em projetos parceiros entenda e adira aos nossos serviços de gestão e decoração, transformando um apartamento vazio em uma máquina de gerar receita.

Seus Desafios Serão:
  • Ativar a carteira de investidores que compram unidades nos empreendimentos parceiros, realizando o primeiro contato pós-compra.

  • Conduzir a venda do nosso produto
  • Lobie Decor , uma solução completa que inclui projeto de arquitetura, compra de itens com custo reduzido pela escala e gestão total da implementação, deixando a unidade pronta para operar.
  • Construir e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança com os investidores, garantindo uma experiência de onboarding fluida e positiva.
  • Realizar a gestão do funil de vendas e atividades no CRM, assegurando o acompanhamento de todos os leads.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de Operações e Marketing para garantir a passagem de bastão perfeita após a contratação dos serviços.
O que Buscamos em Você:
  • Paixão por pessoas e pela construção de relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar o "último metro" do processo comercial.
  • Vivência na área comercial ou de relacionamento com o cliente, preferencialmente B2C.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse pelo mercado imobiliário, de investimentos e/ou design de interiores é um grande diferencial.
Por que se Juntar à Lobie?
  • Impacto Real: Você verá o resultado direto do seu trabalho na receita da companhia e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.
  • Crescimento Acelerado: Faça parte de uma proptech em plena expansão, com o suporte de um dos grupos mais sólidos do setor imobiliário brasileiro.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Trabalhe em um ambiente que combina tecnologia, dados e uma abordagem moderna para um mercado tradicional.
  • Desenvolvimento: Oportunidade de aprender sobre investimentos, mercado imobiliário e vendas consultivas de alto valor.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

Who we are!

What We Offer

Ready to elevate your career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV in English)

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Senior Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Senior Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Senior Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be re sponsible for overseeing information management using BIM (Building Information Modeling) across the project, ensuring all stakeholders meet digital deliverables and project requirements. While the role may involve other digital construction methods such as scanning, drones, and robotics, the primary focus is BIM. The coordinator serves as the main point of contact for BIM between the project management team and external stakeholders including the client, consultants, and subcontractors.

Your Role:

  • Manage and interpret client BIM expectations and deliverables.
  • Communicate information requirements internally and externally.
  • Develop and maintain BIM documentation such as the BIM execution plan, exchange information requirements, responsibility matrix, and master information delivery plan.
  • Set up and manage BIM workflows from contract award through project handover.
  • Ensure the electronic document management system supports the common data environment processes.
  • Lead 3D model coordination and issue resolution, including clash detection.
  • Provide training, coaching, and support for BIM processes and related technologies.
  • Estimate resource requirements for direct and subcontracted works.
  • Implement quality assurance and control for models and BIM processes.
  • Represent BIM and digital construction at project meetings.
  • Report on BIM progress and compliance at the project level.
  • Support tender submissions and contribute to departmental process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and familiarity with the 1192 standards.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring software such as Revit, Tekla, or Archicad.
  • Experience with BIM coordination tools such as Navisworks or Revizto.
  • Knowledge of openBIM standards including IFC and COBie.
  • Ability to use tools for automated model checking and data validation such as Solibri.
  • Experience with cloud-based collaboration platforms used in CDE workflows such as Aconex or BIM 360.
  • Familiarity with scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Experience in programming or visual programming (Dynamo preferred).
  • Understanding of 4D and 5D processes and their implementation.
  • Ability to use data reporting tools such as MS Power BI.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable with a proactive mindset.
  • Confident, assertive, and resilient under pressure.
  • Analytical with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Highly organized with excellent time management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

Experience:

title: BIM Modeler - Civil
description:
Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

description:
Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | DCP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Planejamento em Prevenção de Perdas atua como o cérebro estratégico da operação, conectando análises financeiras, orçamentárias e contratuais à execução prática das ações de mitigação de perdas em toda a cadeia operacional. Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.

Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.
  • Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance.
  • Habilidade em análise de perdas e provisionamento.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos de capital e despesas operacionais.
  • Vivência com sistemas integrados, como: ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, etc.), BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.)
  • Análise estratégica e mindset de negócios.
  • Pacote Office avançado.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Technical Engineer - Design
description:
Technical Engineer - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of Technical Engineer, you will be responsible for managing a section of the build, ensuring that all designs are executed as per specifications, and any changes are effectively resolved and documented.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC documents, 2D drawings, BIM models & asset data in accordance with ISO19650.
  • Identify and resolve conflicting design elements through RFIs, CVIs, and workshops.
  • Oversee civil/infrastructure design deliverables throughout design and construction stages.
  • Support Design Manager in developing key project documentation including Project Execution Plans and QA/QC plans.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary data and proactively mitigate potential constraints.
  • Prepare and manage RFIs/CVIs ensuring clarity and timely responses.
  • Assist in subcontractor coordination, reviewing shop drawings, and ensuring compliance with specifications.
  • Track drawing delivery schedules and support timely document submittals.
  • Liaise with planning teams to update working programmes and address technical queries from site.
  • Support temporary works design including tower cranes, hoists, and formwork systems.
  • Contribute to value engineering initiatives and manage as-built/redline drawing processes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a Technical Engineer or similar role within the construction industry.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks/Revizto, MS Office, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Strong understanding of design review processes and technical coordination.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Pessoa Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

MISSÃO

Atuar de forma estratégica e analítica nas áreas de Controladoria e Planejamento Financeiro, com foco no monitoramento da performance econômico-financeira. Será responsável por acompanhar os indicadores de unidade operacional, contribuindo para a eficiência da gestão orçamentária e a melhoria contínua da rentabilidade do negócio.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Consolidar e analisar resultados financeiros mensais, orçamentos, forecasts e projeções de longo prazo;
  • Acompanhar e o processo orçamentário da unidade operacional e atuar na governança de custos; Apoio na elaboração e análise dos vários exercícios de previsão, orçamento anual e no Plano a Médio Prazo (MTP). Principalmente através da interação e do diálogo com as áreas de negócio;
  • Acompanhar e propor melhorias nos KPIs financeiros e operacionais, com foco em rentabilidade e eficiência;
  • Desenvolver modelos financeiros e relatórios gerenciais para subsidiar decisões estratégicas da diretoria;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação de desvios, riscos e oportunidades financeiras; Analisar, monitorar e comunicar mensalmente o desempenho real, assegurando o alinhamento com os objetivos anuais; Contribuir para o reporte e comunicação da síntese dos resultados reais e do orçamento/MTP da Unidade de Negócio (UN);
  • Participar de comitês financeiros e operacionais, representando a área de controladoria;
  • Apoiar projetos transversais de melhoria contínua, automação e transformação digital financeira

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade;
  • Experiência em Controladoria, planejamento financeiro e análise de performance;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power Point, Power BI ou similares);
  • Capacidade de atuação estratégica, visão de negócio, e comunicação com alta liderança;
  • Inglês avançado.

Diferenciais

  • Pós Graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

LOCAL DE TRABALHO

Rio de Janeiro - RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools : Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Senior System Engineer - Computing Technology
description:
Senior Systems Engineer, Core 42, Abu Dhabi - UAE

Please note this position requires relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE.

About Us

Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.

The opportunity

The Senior Systems Engineer – Computing Technology engages in the design, leads implementation, and provides Level 3 expert support for large-scale private cloud computing infrastructure, with a specific emphasis on computing technologies including hardware layer, operating system, hypervisor, and orchestration services.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Co-design, implement, and manage hybrid virtualization and containerized platforms based on OpenStack, VMware VCF and/or Red Hat OpenShift ensuring platform stability, performance and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams on technology stack component evaluation and selection ensuring solutions are designed following best practices and optimized from both functional and non-functional perspectives.
  • Conduct regular capacity planning exercises to anticipate and accommodate the growing demands on the virtualized environment, ensuring it meets current and future requirements.
  • Develop and implement plans to enhance the reliability of the computing infrastructure, addressing potential points of failure and ensuring high availability of services.
  • Explore, analyze, and implement performance optimization strategies for the cloud computing environment, ensuring optimal resource utilization and responsiveness.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to conduct regular performance assessments and implement improvements based on findings.
  • Prepare and participate in complex changes to production environments supporting operational teams.
  • Develop auto-test and automation solutions for cloud platform using tools like Jenkins and Selenium along with other configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Provide L3 expert support including on-call shifts with focus on immediate incident management and resolutions, such as outages, breaches, and system failures.
  • Write and maintain relevant documentation ensuring completeness and quality.
  • Prepare and provide trainings for operational teams in the related technical domains.
  • Collaborate with security management teams to ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
  • Work closely with process management and operational teams and contribute to process development standardizing collaboration framework and improving collaboration efficiency

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or other relevant technology field.
  • 7+ years of experience and deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing private cloud stacks with the focus on compute and virtualization technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms/stacks: OpenStack, Apache CloudStack, VMware VCF and Red Hat OpenShift and related computing technologies such as x86 hardware, OS, KVM/ESXi and orchestration services.
  • Expert level in Linux and 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux-based environments.
  • Profound understanding of hardware architecture and components (x86 and ARM, NUMA, types of memory and channels, types of NICs, etc.
  • Good understanding of network and storage types and architecture.
  • Good understanding of Cloud Native concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in managing large-scale public or private cloud environments and/or work in a cloud service provider environment is highly desirable.
  • Advanced level in programming and scripting using Python and/or Golang, bash.
  • Good knowledge in Data center network designs and related technologies (OSI model, TCP/IP stack, routing, VLAN/VxLAN, etc)
  • Understanding of storage types, architecture, and protocols such as object/block/file storages, NFS/SMB, iSCSI, FC, etc.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Zabbix or Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaaC) approach and software defined infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience with database management and optimization for both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra is highly desirable.
  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira, Redmine, ServiceNow etc.
  • Relevant certifications in Linux, virtualization and cloud computing are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience working with GPU-hardware and AI hardware accelerators is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

What working at Core42 offers

With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit , where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion , which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact , as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.

  • Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package based on your skills and experience
  • Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
  • Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
  • Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family
  • Learning & Development: We offer access to top-tier learning platforms to help you grow in your career. Learn at your own pace with unlimited access to premium courses.

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

7- Compreensão dos requisitos regulatórios para validação de filtros e expertise na avaliação de robustez de processos de filtração em condições pior caso.

8- Conhecimento em técnicas de amostragem e análise microbiológica para validar o tempo de espera em diferentes condições ambientais e de processo.

9- Conhecimento das diretrizes de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (GMP) e regulamentos de autoridades sanitárias internacionais, como ANVISA, FDA, EMA, e ICH Q7/Q9.

10- Experiência em preparar e revisar documentação técnica para conformidade regulatória, incluindo protocolos e relatórios de validação, além de garantir a rastreabilidade dos dados.

title: Físico(a) Médico(a) I
description:
Físico(a) Médico(a) I

Rio de Janeiro

#VemSerOC

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na Oncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

Atuar na elaboração do planejamento dosimétrico dos pacientes submetidos à radioterapia, assegurando a qualidade e segurança do processo e dos equipamentos, conforme os princípios de proteção radiológica. Definir as especificações técnicas dos aparelhos de radioterapia, incluindo acelerador, aparelho de braquiterapia, simulador, sistema de planejamento e sistema de controle de qualidade. Realizar testes de aceite dos equipamentos após instalação ou reparo, certificando-se de que as unidades de terapia, simulação, imagem e planejamento funcionem de acordo com as especificações de compra. Medir, analisar e, quando necessário, calibrar os dados dosimétricos de uso clínico nas unidades de teleterapia e braquiterapia, seguindo os protocolos adotados. Supervisionar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos.

O que você precisa ter:

• Superior Completo Física ou Física Médica;

• Pós-graduação em Física Médica em Radioterapia.

Local e horário de trabalho:

• Radioterapia Botafogo | Rio de Janeiro

• Segunda a Quinta 08:00 as 18:00 e Sex 08:00 as 17:00

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o CLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO ou a REFEIÇÃO na empresa e para ajudar nas compras do mês, um VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO .

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

Venha construir com a gente!

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

Operar, monitorar e aprimorar as
plataformas de gestão de vulnerabilidades, garantindo a identificação,

correções de segurança (patching) em sistemas operacionais (Windows e Linux),

Aplicar hardening em servidores
físicos e virtualizados, endpoints, firewalls, roteadores e serviços cloud.

VMware, garantindo a proteção de vSphere, ESXi e vCenter .

Automatizar processos de
detecção e correção de vulnerabilidades utilizando scripts e ferramentas de
automação.

Produzir evidências das
vulnerabilidades e conformidade tratadas, para acompanhando junto as métricas
de segurança.

Atuar na gestão de configuração
segura e garantir conformidade com políticas e regulamentos da empresa.

Conhecimento de correção de vulnerabilidades, hardening e segurança em ambientes Microsoft,

gestão de vulnerabilidades como Qualys, Tenable Nessus, Rapid7 ou OpenVAS.

Conhecimento em sistemas
operacionais (Windows Server, Linux – Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL).

Vivência com aplicação de
patches de segurança e mitigação de vulnerabilidades.

Hardening de servidores e
infraestrutura virtualizada, baseado em CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIG e NIST

vCenter.

segurança em dispositivos Cisco (Switches, Firewalls, Routers).

Capacidade de analisar CVE
(Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) e definir estratégias de

resposta a incidentes de segurança.
